# goslop text fixture — task.cancel cleanup then bare re-raise (niquests sgi
# ASGI cancel-then-propagate FP shape)
lang: python
file: sgi_adapter.py
---
import asyncio
import contextlib

async def send(task):
    try:
        return await task
    except Exception:
        task.cancel()
        with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task
        raise
